intro: Jen'shan is a Darkspear jungle troll and hunter trainer stationed in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. She guides fledgling orc and troll marksmen as they take their first steps into the wilds of the Horde. Young hunters are directed to her to learn the basics of tracking, ranged combat, and survival.

p: Perched among the weathered encampments of the Valley of Trials, Jen'shan serves as the primary hunter mentor for new recruits proving their worth to the Horde. Together, young orcs and Darkspear trolls arrive clutching inscribed tablets and parchments directing them straight to her side. With keen eyes sharpened by years in the untamed wilderness, she imparts foundational techniques in archery, marksmanship, and wilderness survival, ensuring no novice falls prey to the scorpids and boars prowling the canyon floor.
